pay_detail: Initial cost $95 plus $10 a month dues. Extra fees for special trips. Financial help is available. You buy your own uniform and safety shoes.
name: Seattle Fire Cadet Program (Company 511)
what_you_do: Train on Saturdays at the fire department training facility to learn what firefighting is like. You get a helmet, coat, pants, boots and gloves for training.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 22. You must complete the Cadet Program Physical Ability Test, meet attendance expectations and want to be a Seattle firefighter.
deadline_text: Applications accepted all year. Apply Feb 1 to July 31 and hear back in August. Apply Aug 1 to Jan 31 and hear back in February.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Fire Cadet application and email it with the required documents to SFD_Cadets@seattle.gov. See the selection process guidelines on the page.
notes: This is training, not a paid job. The city page also describes the department as encouraging women, people of color, immigrants and refugees to apply.
